# Cloak

> Private trading on Elysium (testnet): sealed-bid token launches, and trades, sends and withdrawals from a private balance, proven locally and sent by a relayer.

AI agents: read https://cloak.boblabs.tech/agent.md and follow it. It sets you up and says what to ask the person.

- [Agent instructions](https://cloak.boblabs.tech/agent.md)
- [Docs](https://cloak.boblabs.tech/docs)
- [MCP server on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cloakely/mcp)
- [SDK on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cloakely/sdk)
